description: Record the ground rules in docs/GROUND_RULES.md, create progress.txt and .gitignore
steps: Create .gitignore with at least: `.pio/`, `build/`, `*.bin`, `*.elf`, `*.map`, `android/**/build/`, `android/.gradle/`, `android/local.properties`, `.DS_Store`, `*.apk` (except nothing under fixtures/). Keep any line already present.

Product statement (verbatim, top of the file): 'Plug an ESP32-S3 into an Android phone over USB-OTG, open one app, and the phone becomes the Cardputer: the ESP runs the app, the phone IS its screen, keyboard, GPS and app launcher. The ESP needs no display or keyboard of its own.' The product ESP is a bare ESP32-S3 (the Cardputer's StampS3 class: ESP32-S3, 8 MB flash). A real Cardputer ADV is used in the spikes ONLY because it is in hand and its own TFT gives ground truth next to the phone. The ESP is always the brain; the phone adds zero computation. Bruce firmware is NOT the target and must not appear as a dependency anywhere in this ledger; it is at most one future catalog entry.

Mechanism (from SPEC.md finding B, verified): ESP32 binaries are statically linked, so the phone cannot mirror arbitrary M5Burner binaries. What works is a display+keyboard SHIM: a patched copy of M5GFX (LovyanGFX Panel_LCD write path: setWindow / writePixels / writeBlock / writeImage / writeFillRectPreclipped / drawPixelPreclipped) that tees every pixel write to USB-CDC, plus a patched M5Cardputer Keyboard_Class that merges key events received over USB. Any open-source Cardputer app REBUILT against the shim runs on the phone unchanged. Bruce's tft_logger (TFT_eSPI) is prior art for the same pattern.

Repo layout to be created by later tasks: `shim/` (PlatformIO library DroidputterShim = patched M5GFX + patched M5Cardputer keyboard + USB framing), `tools/` (host-side Python receiver/renderer and capture tools), `fixtures/` (captured real streams, committed), `apps/` (build recipes for rebuilt apps; first one = Pense-Bem at /Users/fcavalcanti/dev/m5/cardputter-pense-pem), `android/` (Gradle project: `core` pure-JVM Kotlin module + `app` Android module), `docs/`.

Golden rules: Kotlin `android/core` has ZERO `android.*` imports and >=80% line coverage (TDD against fixtures); `android/app` is a dumb shell (render + forward keys, no protocol logic); C++ shim code never allocates per pixel write and never blocks the app longer than the USB TX buffer allows; every code file <= 900 lines; no stubs in production paths; label every hardware result [REAL], test-only [TEST], reasoning [UNVERIFIED].

Toolchain facts: PlatformIO 6.x with `espressif32@6.12.0` (arduino-esp32 2.0.17), board `m5stack-stamps3`, libs M5Unified ^0.2.20 / M5Cardputer ^1.1.1 / M5GFX 0.2.27 (vendored copy exists at /Users/fcavalcanti/dev/m5/cardputter-pense-pem/.pio/libdeps/m5cardputer/). Android: SDK at ~/Library/Android/sdk (platforms 34/35/36, build-tools 35.0.0 + 36.1.0), JDK = `/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home` (JBR 21), `adb` at /opt/homebrew/bin/adb, AVD `Medium_Phone_API_36.1` (no USB in the emulator: USB tasks need the real Poco X7 Pro over WIRELESS adb because its USB-C is on the ESP).

Hardware clause used by every hardware task: If the Cardputer ADV is not attached (`ls /dev/cu.usbmodem*` prints nothing), do every build-only step, append a `UAT:` line to progress.txt describing exactly what a human must confirm on hardware, and still mark the task passed.

Write all of the above into docs/GROUND_RULES.md, create progress.txt with the single line `# progress journal`, and verify: `test -s docs/GROUND_RULES.md && test -s progress.txt && git check-ignore -q .pio`.

description: Write docs/PROTOCOL.md — the Droidputter wire protocol v0 (ESP <-> phone over USB-CDC)
steps: Framing (both directions): sync `0xD7 0x50` ('DP'), type u8, length u16 little-endian (payload bytes), payload, crc8 (poly 0x07 over type+length+payload). Max payload 4096 B. A receiver that loses sync scans forward for the next `0xD7 0x50` whose crc8 validates.

ESP -> phone types: 0x01 HELLO {proto u8=0, w u16, h u16, rotation u8, bpp u8 (16), board name up to 16 chars, app name up to 32 chars}; 0x02 FILL {x,y,w,h u16, color RGB565 u16}; 0x03 RECT {x,y,w,h u16, then w*h*2 bytes RGB565 in row-major order, big-endian as the panel receives them}; 0x04 RECT_RLE {x,y,w,h u16, then runs of (count u8, color u16)} — emitted only when it is shorter than RECT; 0x05 STATS {frames u32, bytes u32, dropped u32} once per second; 0x06 PING.

phone -> ESP types: 0x81 KEY {row u8, col u8, state u8 (1 down / 0 up)} using the Cardputer 4x14 physical matrix coordinates (row 0 = top row `esc..del`, col 0 = leftmost); 0x82 GPS_NMEA {one NMEA sentence, no CRLF} (reserved for the GPS milestone); 0x83 PING; 0x84 HELLO_ACK {phone screen w,h u16}.

State the bandwidth budget from SPEC.md finding C: a full 240x135 RGB565 frame is 64,800 B; ESP32-S3 USB-Serial/JTAG is USB full-speed (12 Mbit/s), realistic 300-800 KB/s, so full-frame redraws are 5-12 fps and partial (dirty-rect) redraws are what makes text apps feel instant. The receiver must tolerate dropped frames: STATS.dropped > 0 is reported, not fatal.
Write the byte layout table for every type and one worked example per direction (hex bytes + meaning).
Verify: `test -s docs/PROTOCOL.md` and the file contains the strings `0xD7 0x50`, `RECT_RLE`, `KEY {row` and `64,800`.

description: HELLO/STATS/PING and the USB link state machine in droidputter.cpp
steps: HELLO sent at begin and whenever a PING or HELLO_ACK arrives (so a phone that connects late gets the geometry); STATS every 1000 ms; a link is 'up' only after HELLO_ACK, and while 'down' the tee is silent (no USB writes) so an app on the ESP alone runs at full speed.

Full-frame resync: on HELLO_ACK the shim requests a repaint by emitting one RECT of the panel's current contents if the panel supports readPixels (ST7789 on the Cardputer: use `readRect`), else emits FILL black and relies on the app's next redraw. Record which path the Cardputer takes.
Verify: with the receiver started AFTER the ESP booted, the Mac shows the current screen within 2 s (a [REAL] line in progress.txt), and `pio test -e native` still passes.

Tests: happy path; permission denied -> Error; detach while Linked -> Reconnecting; 3 missed pings -> Reconnecting.
Verify: `./gradlew :core:test` exits 0.

description: Transport interface + fake: `interface DpTransport { write(bytes); incoming: Flow<ByteArray> }` and a replay transport that plays a fixture with its recorded timing
steps: `FixtureTransport(path)` replays fixtures/*.jsonl chunks at recorded timestamps (optionally at speed factor N); used by tests and by the app's demo mode.
Tests: replaying fixtures/pense-bem/boot.jsonl through Framer+ScreenModel yields the same final framebuffer as the direct .bin replay.
Verify: `./gradlew :core:test` exits 0.

description: USB-OTG transport with usb-serial-for-android: attach intent, permission, CDC-ACM open, single reader thread
steps: Manifest: `<uses-feature android:name="android.hardware.usb.host"/>`, activity intent-filter `USB_DEVICE_ATTACHED` with res/xml/device_filter.xml (vendor-id 12346 = 0x303A; also CDC class match), permission broadcast receiver.

`UsbDpTransport`: `UsbSerialProber.getDefaultProber()` plus a custom ProbeTable adding VID 0x303A to `CdcAcmSerialDriver`; open, `setParameters(115200,8,1,NONE)`, `setDTR(true)`, `setRTS(true)`, `SerialInputOutputManager` feeding a Flow; `purgeHwBuffers` on close. Detach -> emits event to the state machine; re-enumeration after ESP reset must reconnect without user action beyond the OS permission dialog.

Verify: `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug` exits 0; static gate passes. Hardware: with the Poco on WIRELESS adb (`adb pair`/`adb connect`), install the APK (`adb install -r`), plug the Cardputer ADV running the S2 shim build: logcat shows `HELLO` decoded within 2 s of granting permission. UAT line if no phone.

description: Renderer: full-screen Compose Canvas draws the ScreenModel framebuffer scaled with integer nearest-neighbour, landscape, letterboxed
steps: Convert RGB565 -> ARGB into a reused Bitmap only for dirty rects; invalidate at most 60 Hz; show the HELLO app/board name in a thin status bar.
Demo mode (no USB): a 'Replay fixture' button plays fixtures/pense-bem/boot.jsonl through FixtureTransport so the renderer is verifiable on the emulator.

Verify: `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug` exits 0; on the AVD `Medium_Phone_API_36.1` the demo replay shows the Pense-Bem screen (screenshot saved via `adb exec-out screencap -p > docs/img/demo-replay.png`).

description: Soft Cardputer keyboard: 4x14 on-screen keys sending KEY down/up, plus hardware-keyboard passthrough
steps: Compose grid using the core key table (legends, shift/fn modifiers held as sticky keys), touch down -> KEY down, up -> KEY up; physical KeyEvents mapped through the core map; haptic tick optional.

Verify: `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug` exits 0. Hardware: pressing `1` on the phone starts Adição in Pense-Bem on the TFT and the phone screen follows within the S3-measured latency (record [REAL] in progress.txt); UAT line if no phone.

description: Connection screen: device list, permission state, link state, STATS (fps, KB/s, dropped) and a 'Reconnect' action
steps: State from the core state machine; a persistent notification while linked (foreground service) so the link survives screen-off; 'Send HELLO_ACK again' as the resync action.

Verify: `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug` exits 0. Hardware: unplug/replug the Cardputer 10 times; the app returns to Linked each time without restarting the app (record [REAL] count); UAT line if no phone.

description: GPS feed: the app streams phone location as GPS_NMEA frames while linked (foreground location permission)
steps: Request ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION; prefer `LocationManager.addNmeaListener` raw sentences (normalised), fall back to `NmeaSynth` from `GPS_PROVIDER` fixes when no NMEA arrives for 3 s (Android goes silent on fused/network fixes — SPEC finding D). Toggle in the connection screen; show last sentence + fix status.

If the target board is not attached (`ls /dev/cu.usbmodem*` prints nothing), do every build-only step, append a `UAT:` line to progress.txt describing exactly what a human must confirm on hardware, and still mark the task passed. Hardware: apps/gps-demo on the Cardputer ADV linked to the phone shows the phone's lat/lon and satellite count on BOTH the TFT and the phone screen within 10 s outdoors (or a synthesized fix indoors). Record [REAL].
Verify: `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug` exits 0 and progress.txt has the GPS [REAL] line (or UAT).

description: End-to-end on the phone: Pense-Bem fully playable from the Android screen and keyboard (the north-star demo)
steps: With the S2/S3 shim build on the Cardputer ADV and the phone linked: play one Adição round (10 questions) using only the phone. If the Cardputer ADV is not attached (`ls /dev/cu.usbmodem*` prints nothing), do every build-only step, append a `UAT:` line to progress.txt describing exactly what a human must confirm on hardware, and still mark the task passed.
Then repeat with the VIRTUAL build (TFT dark or bare ESP32-S3 devkit if approved): the phone is the only screen and keyboard. This is the north-star proof: bare ESP32-S3 + phone = a Cardputer.

Record: key-to-screen latency (median of 10 keypresses measured by the app's STATS/timestamps), dropped frames, battery/OTG behaviour (does the phone power the Cardputer with its own battery removed from the loop — note the charge LED). Label [REAL].
Record a 30 s screen recording via `adb shell screenrecord` into docs/img/demo.mp4 (git-ignored if > 5 MB; link it in README).
Verify: progress.txt has the end-to-end [REAL] line with a latency number.

description: Catalog manifest format: apps/catalog.json lists droidputter-ready builds (name, board, version, bin parts with offsets, sha256, source repo, license)
steps: Write apps/catalog.json with the Pense-Bem and m5-example entries produced by the spike builds; a script tools/make_catalog.py regenerates it from apps/*/ build outputs and computes sha256.
Verify: `python3 tools/make_catalog.py --check` exits 0 and `jq length apps/catalog.json` prints >= 2.

description: Catalog screen in the app: list apps from apps/catalog.json (bundled asset), show details, and hand off flashing to ESP32_Flasher with a one-tap share of the bin parts
steps: Until a native flasher exists (later milestone), the app shares the bin parts + a text with the offsets to any installed flasher app via the Android share sheet. Document this hand-off in docs/FLASHING.md.
Verify: `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug` exits 0. Hardware: sharing Pense-Bem parts to ESP32_Flasher and flashing them boots Pense-Bem (record [REAL]); UAT line if no phone.

description: Third-party app onboarding recipe: docs/PORTING.md — how any open-source Cardputer app gets a droidputter build
steps: Document the overlay pattern (lib_extra_dirs + -DDROIDPUTTER=1 + 3-line hook), the M5GFX/M5Cardputer version constraints, what breaks (apps that talk to the panel bus directly, TFT_eSPI apps: not covered yet), and how to add the result to apps/catalog.json.
Verify: docs/PORTING.md exists and names the three overlay ingredients.

description: Other boards: ESP32-C5 (arduino core 3.x needed) and StickS3 #2 — build the virtual/tee overlays and record per-board status
steps: Add a `Panel_Droidputter` virtual panel to the shim (an LGFX panel with no bus that only feeds the tee, width/height from build flags) so M5GFX/M5Unified apps build for boards without a display; build apps/m5-example for `[env:esp32-c5]` (arduino core >= 3.x required for C5: note the toolchain gap in progress.txt if espressif32@6.12.0 cannot target it and fall back to the bare ESP32-S3-N16R8 devkit only with Felipe's explicit OK, since INVENTORY reserves it for esp-claw).

Hardware clause per board; C5 caveats from INVENTORY: J5 jumper bridged with a cap, native USB port (not the CP2102N UART port), esptool >= 5.3.0 at ~/Library/Arduino15/packages/esp32/tools/esptool_py/5.3.0/esptool.
Verify: the chosen headless build exits 0 and, on hardware, the Mac receiver shows the example UI from a board with no screen ([REAL] line or UAT).

description: Coverage and static gates
steps: `./gradlew :core:koverVerify` (>= 80% line) exits 0; `android/gates.sh` prints 0 android imports in core; `cd shim && pio test -e native` exits 0; `grep -rn 'malloc\|new ' shim/lib/DroidputterShim/src/dp_display.cpp | grep -v '//' | wc -l` prints 0 (no per-write allocation).
Verify: all four commands exit 0 with the stated output.

description: Fresh-clone build gate
steps: `d=$(mktemp -d) && git clone <this repo> $d/dp && cd $d/dp/android && ./gradlew :core:test :app:assembleDebug && cd ../shim && pio test -e native && cd ../apps/pense-bem && pio run` — every command exits 0 (PlatformIO may download the platform; network is allowed for this gate).
Verify: exit 0 for the whole chain.

description: Soak: 30 minutes linked, Pense-Bem idle + periodic keypresses, no leak, no drop growth
steps: If the Cardputer ADV is not attached (`ls /dev/cu.usbmodem*` prints nothing), do every build-only step, append a `UAT:` line to progress.txt describing exactly what a human must confirm on hardware, and still mark the task passed. Hardware: STATS.dropped does not grow while idle; app heap stable (`adb shell dumpsys meminfo com.droidputter` before/after within 10%); ESP free heap printed by the shim at start and end within 2 KB.
Verify: progress.txt has the soak [REAL] line with the four numbers.

description: Rewrite SPEC.md roadmap to match the north star: M1 shim + USB app (this ledger), M2 catalog + native flasher, M3 GPS/peripherals through the shim, M4 more boards/libraries (TFT_eSPI shim, LovyanGFX-only apps), and move Bruce to an appendix as prior art only
steps: Keep the verified research findings, correct the wired-mode table (screen over USB = shim, proven in S2), and add the measured numbers from S2/S3/S5.
Verify: `grep -c -i bruce SPEC.md` is lower than before the edit and the roadmap section names M1..M4 as above.

description: README.md: what it is, the demo GIF/MP4, how to build the shim overlay for your app, how to flash from a phone, status table per board
steps: Verify: README links docs/PROTOCOL.md, docs/PORTING.md, docs/FLASHING.md and apps/catalog.json.

description: AGENTS.md for the new tree: layout, golden rules, the hardware clause, how to run every gate, and the Solvr room `droidputter` for coordination
steps: Verify: `test -s AGENTS.md` and it contains the strings `pio test -e native`, `koverVerify` and `droidputter`.
